title: Integrating spectral and morphological plant features with decision-tree models for early-season cotton biomass and nitrogen status estimation from multi-year UAV data
abstract: arXiv:2608.07801v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Precision nitrogen (N) management (PNM) for cotton requires in-season monitoring of crop growth parameters and N status indicators to decide fertilizer timing, placement, and application rates for optimal canopy development and yield. This study developed remote sensing and machine learning-based methods to estimate cotton dry biomass weight (DBW), plant N uptake (PNU), plant N concentration (PNC), critical N dilution (Nc), and nitrogen nutrition index (NNI) to support PNM. To achieve this, a three-year field-based N-management study was conducted and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based multispectral images were acquired between early vegetative growth and flowering stages, critical for fertilizer applications. Spatiotemporally consistent spectral and morphological plant features, including plant height (PH) and fractional canopy cover (FCC), provided reliable model training inputs. translated_title: 结合光谱与形态植物特征及决策树模型，基于多年无人机数据估算棉花生长季早期的生物量和氮素状况
translated_abstract: 摘要：棉花精准氮素管理（PNM）需要季节内监测作物生长参数和氮素状况指标，以决定施肥时间、位置和施用量，从而实现最佳冠层发育和产量。本研究开发了基于遥感和机器学习的方法，用于估算棉花干生物量重量（DBW）、植株氮吸收量（PNU）、植株氮浓度（PNC）、临界氮稀释（Nc）和氮营养指数（NNI），以支持PNM。为此，进行了为期三年的田间氮素管理试验，并在营养生长早期至开花期（对施肥关键期）获取了基于无人机（UAV）的多光谱图像。时空一致的光谱和形态植物特征，包括株高（PH）和冠层覆盖率（FCC），提供了可靠的模型训练输入。来自简单回归的DBW、PNU和PNC估算值……
tldr: 本研究利用无人机多光谱数据结合光谱与形态特征，通过决策树模型实现了棉花生长季早期的生物量和氮素状况高效估算，为精准氮肥管理提供了可靠支持。
en_tdlr: This study integrates UAV multispectral data with spectral and morphological features using decision-tree models to efficiently estimate early-season cotton biomass and nitrogen status, supporting precision nitrogen management.
